content:
I got the the following warning on top of the current main branch. Anything wrong?

$ lake exe mk_all
⚠ [83/163] Replayed mk_all
warning: scripts/mk_all.lean: missing `module` header as required by the `requiresModuleSystem` option
No update necessary

No, everything should still work as expected. Details if you're interested:

The mk_all script lives upstream in Mathlib. They recently switched to setting requiresModuleSystem := true in their lakefile, but not all of their scripts use the module system yet. So it is expected to temporarily see these warning in the meantime.
